verdict.label: Works for shoppers, but tracking needs fixes
verdict.summary: The page sells, but 3 high-severity tracking issues mean ad platforms would get wrong numbers. Fix (or confirm) these before scaling spend.

findings.title: Two Meta pixels both report "ViewContent"
findings.finding: Each time the shopper viewed the product, the event is sent to 2 pixels: 223335195137418 (via tmgoogletagmanager) and 558552204508330 (via shopify_web_pixel).
findings.impact: If both pixels sit in the same ad account or dataset, Meta counts each conversion twice and reported ROAS is overstated. If they belong to separate accounts (e.g. an agency), this is intentional.
findings.action: Confirm in Meta Events Manager which pixel your campaigns optimise on; retire the other or remove it from this site.

findings.finding: Each time the shopper added to cart, the event is sent to 2 pixels: 223335195137418 (via tmgoogletagmanager) and 558552204508330 (via shopify_web_pixel).
findings.impact: If both pixels sit in the same ad account or dataset, Meta counts each conversion twice and reported ROAS is overstated. If they belong to separate accounts (e.g. an agency), this is intentional.
findings.action: Confirm in Meta Events Manager which pixel your campaigns optimise on; retire the other or remove it from this site.

findings.impact: If both pixels sit in the same ad account or dataset, Meta counts each conversion twice and reported ROAS is overstated. If they belong to separate accounts (e.g. an agency), this is intentional.
findings.action: Confirm in Meta Events Manager which pixel your campaigns optimise on; retire the other or remove it from this site.

findings.title: 5 uncaught JavaScript errors on the page
findings.finding: Script errors were thrown: 1 during "Scrolling through the page", 2 during "Tapping the first product in the list", 1 during "Tapping "Add to cart" before choosing a size", 1 during "Starting checkout (no order placed)".
findings.impact: A crashing script can stop a tag (or a button) from working for some shoppers. None broke the tested journey, but they make the page fragile.
findings.action: Have a developer trace each error to its script and fix or remove it.

findings.title: Extra page views counted with no new page (choosing an in-stock size / adding the item to the cart)
findings.finding: No new page loaded, but 6 page-view hits went out (Meta Pixel 223335195137418, Meta Pixel 558552204508330, Google Ads AW-766814719, Google Analytics 4 G-3042L5GP9T, Google Analytics 4 G-5RYZDGXEFH, Google Analytics 4 G-VDE0ZFZ4LP). The theme rewrites the address bar (history change) when a size is picked, and the tags treat that as a new page.
findings.impact: Page views and sessions are inflated and engagement rate / bounce rate are distorted. Meta also receives extra PageView signals.
findings.action: In GA4 turn off "page changes based on browser history events" (or exclude this theme's replaceState), and remove History Change triggers from page-view tags in GTM.

findings.title: 2 Google Analytics properties track this page
findings.finding: Page views go to G-3042L5GP9T, G-VDE0ZFZ4LP. Ecommerce events go to: G-3042L5GP9T.
findings.impact: Teams reading different properties will see different numbers; any property linked to Google Ads must have complete ecommerce data.
findings.action: Document which property is the source of truth and which is linked to Google Ads; remove stale ones.

findings.title: 3 Google Ads conversion actions fire when the shopper viewed the product
findings.finding: One shopper action triggered: AW-766814719 u-vGCKSF3_YbEP_T0u0C; AW-766814719 CXh7CI2gxvoaEP_T0u0C; AW-766814719 Lej_CISgxvoaEP_T0u0C.
findings.impact: If more than one is set as a "Primary" conversion, Google Ads counts this action several times and bids on inflated numbers.
findings.action: In Google Ads → Goals → Conversions, keep exactly one of these as Primary for this action; mark the rest Secondary or remove them.

findings.title: 4 Google Ads conversion actions fire when the shopper added to cart
findings.finding: One shopper action triggered: AW-766814719 lwnICJ6F3_YbEP_T0u0C; AW-766814719 q-ZgCJzr64UYEP_T0u0C; AW-766814719 zbObCJD0uPoaEP_T0u0C; AW-766814719 DPvOCNCi7ZEdEP_T0u0C.
findings.impact: If more than one is set as a "Primary" conversion, Google Ads counts this action several times and bids on inflated numbers.
findings.action: In Google Ads → Goals → Conversions, keep exactly one of these as Primary for this action; mark the rest Secondary or remove them.

findings.title: 6 Google Ads conversion tags report a value of ₹0
findings.finding: Older GTM conversion tags fire on shopper actions with value 0: Tapping the first product in the list → label CXh7CI2gxvoaEP_T0u0C; Tapping the first product in the list → label Lej_CISgxvoaEP_T0u0C; Adding the item to the cart → label q-ZgCJzr64UYEP_T0u0C; Adding the item to the cart → label zbObCJD0uPoaEP_T0u0C; Adding the item to the cart → label DPvOCNCi7ZEdEP_T0u0C; Starting checkout (no order placed) → label ubtwCIegxvoaEP_T0u0C.
findings.impact: If any of these are used in Max Conversion Value / Target ROAS bidding, Google learns that these conversions are worth nothing.
findings.action: Pass the cart value into these tags, or confirm they are Secondary (observation-only) conversions.

findings.title: Meta Pixel reports its own errors in the browser
findings.finding: [Meta Pixel] - Invalid parameter format for currency.
findings.impact: Meta rejects or ignores the malformed parameter, so the affected event loses value or matching data.
findings.action: Find the custom event sending the bad parameter (Meta Pixel Helper shows it) and fix its format.

findings.title: Ad link goes through a redirect before the page loads
findings.finding: /collections/sneakers redirects to /collections/sneakers-1 on the same site; the page then loads normally.
findings.impact: Adds a little load time to every paid click, and the ad depends on the redirect never being removed.
findings.action: Update the ad's final URL to https://neemans.com/collections/sneakers-1.

findings.title: 90 outside domains load on this page (28+ separate vendors)
findings.finding: 656 requests went to 90 outside domains; 28 vendors could be named, the rest are unidentified (full list in the appendix).
findings.impact: Each vendor adds load time and another script that can break. Old, unused vendors are common in this list.
findings.action: Review the vendor list with marketing and remove anything no one is using.

findings.title: Google Ads: no "begin_checkout" event when the shopper started checkout
findings.finding: The shopper started checkout, but Google Ads never received "begin_checkout". A classic conversion tag did fire at this step (label ubtwCIegxvoaEP_T0u0C).
findings.impact: Probably covered by the classic conversion tag; only matters if remarketing audiences rely on the standard event.
findings.action: Add or fix the "begin_checkout" tag/trigger for this step.

findings.title: GA4 does not record which product was tapped in the list
findings.finding: No "select_item" event when the shopper opened a product from the collection.
findings.impact: List click-through rates per product are unavailable.

findings.title: Same action tracked under two event names in GA4
findings.finding: Alongside the standard events, GA4 also receives: ADD-TO-CART-GA4-V2 (≈ add_to_cart).
findings.impact: Harmless on its own, but if someone marks the custom one as a key event or imports it into Google Ads, the action is counted twice.
findings.action: Retire the legacy custom events, or make sure only the standard event is a key event.

findings.title: All tracking is switched on before the visitor agrees to anything
findings.finding: Consent Mode default is "granted" for ad_storage, ad_user_data, ad_personalization, analytics_storage, and no consent banner changed it.
findings.impact: Good for measurement: nothing is held back. The risk is regulatory: India's DPDP Act requires consent for processing personal data, with its rules being phased in. A legal call, not a launch blocker.
findings.action: Confirm the policy with legal; if a banner is added later, re-run this audit to make sure tags still fire after "Accept".

findings.title: In stock (6 of 6 sizes available)
Add to cart works (size UK 6 landed in the cart)
Main content appears quickly (LCP 1.1s)
findings.finding: Largest Contentful Paint: 1.11s (good ≤ 2.5s). Measured once on an emulated phone over a fast connection — real shoppers on 4G will see it slower.
findings.impact: Slow pages lose paid visitors before they see the product, and Google Ads gives slow pages a worse landing-page score.
findings.action: Compress the hero image, defer non-essential third-party scripts.

findings.title: Layout is stable (CLS 0.022)
findings.finding: Cumulative Layout Shift: 0.022 (good ≤ 0.1). Measured once on an emulated phone over a fast connection — real shoppers on 4G will see it slower.
findings.impact: Content that moves under a thumb causes mis-taps and frustration on mobile.
findings.action: Reserve space for banners, images and widgets that load late.
